title: Sign in
reasonManual: Sign in with Google or GitHub to use MySQL and the AI Mentor.
reasonMysql: MySQL runs on a real server and every session costs resources, so sign-in is required to keep your session and limit usage.
postgresFree: PostgreSQL runs in your browser. Without signing in you can still run 2 trials with basic statements.
storageBlocked: Your browser blocks temporary storage, so the SQL you are writing may be lost when you go to the sign-in page. Copy it first.

banner.cancelled: You cancelled the sign-in. Nothing changed.
banner.failed: Sign-in did not succeed. Please try again.
banner.logoutFailed: Could not sign out. Please try again.
banner.storageBlocked: Your browser blocks temporary storage, so the SQL you are writing may be lost when you go to the sign-in page. Copy your SQL, then press Sign in again.

mysql.needsLogin: MySQL requires sign-in. Sign in to continue.
mysql.ready: You are signed in. Real MySQL sessions arrive in a later release; for now you can check the sign-in gate and your quota.
mysql.ok: Passed the sign-in gate and quota.
mysql.exceededTitle: All {limit} MySQL uses for today are spent
mysql.resetUnknown: It is not known when your quota comes back.
mysql.unavailableBody: The quota could not be checked right now. This is not because you ran out; try again in a few minutes.

guest.left: {left} of {total} trial runs left without signing in.
guest.limit: You have used all {total} trial runs. Nothing was run and the SQL in the editor is untouched. Sign in to keep running.
guest.blocked: This statement needs sign-in. Without signing in you can only run SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and CREATE TABLE. Nothing was run and no trial run was counted.
guest.parser: The statement could not be checked right now, so nothing was run and no trial run was counted. Try again in a few seconds.
guest.locked: The {tab} tab needs sign-in. Without signing in you can view Schema and Plan.

page.lead: Google or GitHub. Signing in opens real MySQL, the AI Mentor and the B-Tree, Try a fix and Capacity tabs.
page.note: Without signing in you can still run PostgreSQL {total} times with basic statements, and view Schema and Plan.
page.unavailable: The sign-in server did not answer. Try again in a few minutes, or try without signing in.
page.caption: A sample B-Tree: the key falls from the root through internal nodes to a leaf, then to the heap. The numbers are only an illustration.
